svg.title: Tukana II musical gesture evidence 210-240 seconds
svg.text: LAISE V1.3A | Musical Gesture Intelligence | 210-240 s
Absolute stereo RMS: common 0..0.01729 FS axis for every stem. No per-stem gain normalization.
Each lane: envelope; original attacks; impulse / pulse / sustain / trend / spatial / phrase tracks. Hover gestures for evidence.
Time in seconds. Simultaneous evidence layers may overlap; PHRASE is a temporal grouping proxy, not musicological ground truth.
